app.title: Programming Center
app.footer: BigFred Programming Center — part of the BigFred project. Released as open-source software.
app.confirmLogoutBody: Unsaved CV changes will be discarded and the session table cleared.
app.disabledHint: Set "enabled": true in $DATA_DIR/etc/bigfred/programming-center/config.json (takes effect without a restart).
app.pickLocoEmpty: No locomotives with a DCC address.
app.pickLocoFilter: Filter by name, DCC address or carrier

login.heading: Programming Center
login.lead: Sign in with an organizer account to program decoders on the layout.
login.layoutHint: Choose the layout the locomotive is on.
login.layoutsError: Could not load the layout list.
login.stateMismatch: Invalid sign-in state — please try again.

home.heading: Choose a decoder
home.lead: Choose one of the decoders we support
home.esuAmbiguous: CV 8 = 151 (ESU). LokSound v5 was selected — v4 and v5 share this ID. If this is v4, pick it manually.
home.detectUnknown: Unknown manufacturer (CV 8 = {{id}}). Generic NMRA profile selected.

features.cvHint: Decoder CV list — read and write one at a time
features.speedHint: NMRA curve: Vstart, Vmid, Vhigh, acceleration and braking
features.addressHint: Short address (CV 1) or long address (CV 17/18 and CV 29)
features.volumeHint: 0–100 slider mapped onto the decoder’s master CV
features.mappingHint: Which key turns on which wire

zimo.hluAccelNote: On MS the higher of CV 3 and CV 49 applies (not the sum). CV 3 × 0.9 s; CV 49 × 0.4 s.
zimo.hluBrakeNote: On MS the higher of CV 4 and CV 50 applies. CV 4 and 349 × 0.9 s; CV 50 × 0.4 s.

esu.tableNote: CV 67 = 1 and CV 94 = 255 are fixed. CV 2 and CV 5 scale the curve (Vmin / Vmax).
esu.accelNote: CV 3 × 0.896 s from standstill to Vmax (LokSound 5 DCC). CV 23 trims the time. Distance grows with speed.
esu.brakeNote: CV 4 × 0.896 s. CV 24 trims the time. Brake functions shorten CV 4 and may cap speed while active.

address.heading: DCC address
address.railcomPlusHint: If the address will not stick, turn RailComPlus off. Automatic locomotive recognition at the command station can overwrite CV 29.

mapping.heading: Output mapping
mapping.nmraHint: Which key turns on which wire.
mapping.pickKey: Pick a key, then tap the outputs it should drive.
mapping.anyKey: Allow any key to drive any output
mapping.anyKeyTooltip: Higher keys can turn on the same wires as F0–F2, not only the later ones.
mapping.swissHint: Extra lighting scenes on top of the keys above.
mapping.fkeyTooltip: The function key that turns this scene on.
mapping.invert: On when the key is off
mapping.invertTooltip: On when the key is off.
mapping.mkey: Turns off that key’s usual lights
mapping.mkeyTooltip: While this scene is on, the usual lights of that key go off.
mapping.requireBothTooltip: The scene stays off until both keys are on.
mapping.keepFwd: Keep usual lights when going forward
mapping.keepFwdTooltip: Usual lights of that key stay on in the forward direction.
mapping.keepRev: Keep usual lights when going reverse
mapping.keepRevTooltip: Usual lights of that key stay on in the reverse direction.
mapping.dimSlotTooltip: How bright this wire is while the scene is on.
mapping.pwmTooltip: How bright the lamps are when high beam is not boosting them.

esu.rowsHint: Each scene fires when every selected condition matches.
esu.outputsHint: Brightness, lighting effect, and LED options for each physical output.
esu.conditions: When does this scene turn on?
esu.confirmApplyTitle: Write mapping CVs to the decoder?
esu.confirmApplyBody: This writes {{count}} indexed CVs. The index registers (CV 31/32) are set for each page first.
esu.confirmDiscardBody: Staged mapping values will be thrown away.

backup.heading: Backup
backup.confirmRestoreBody: This writes {{count}} CVs to the locomotive. Type the number of CVs to confirm.

changes.confirmDiscardBody: Staged CV values will be thrown away.

changeLists.name: Name
changeLists.confirmReplaceBody: “{{name}}” will be overwritten with the current staged CVs.
changeLists.confirmOverwriteDiffsBody: Loading this list will replace the CVs you have already staged.

errors.unauthorized: Session expired — please sign in again.
errors.dcc_bus_unavailable: No connection to the command station (dcc-bus). Open the layout in BigFred.
errors.no_programming_station: No command station has programming enabled.
errors.programming_timeout: The command station did not answer in time.
errors.address_reverted: The address reverted. Try turning RailComPlus off (CV 28 bit 7) and save again on the programming track.
errors.z21_not_configured: programmingMode z21 needs z21.hostname and z21.port in config.json.
errors.z21_required: This action needs programmingMode z21 (direct Z21 connection).
errors.z21_unreachable: The Z21 did not answer on the LAN.
errors.pc_disabled: Programming Center is disabled in configuration.
errors.empty_changelist: A change list cannot be empty.
errors.network_error: Cannot reach the Programming Center server.
errors.address_read_failed: Could not read the DCC address from the decoder.
errors.invalid_redirect_uri: Invalid OAuth redirect URI — sign in via localhost or add your IP to redirectUris.
errors.invalid_address: DCC address must be an integer from 1 to 10239.
errors.standalone_no_sso: Standalone mode does not use BigFred sign-in.
errors.standalone_no_proxy: Standalone mode does not talk to BigFred.
errors.ws_timeout: Could not open the programming WebSocket.
errors.short_circuit: Short circuit on the programming track.
errors.ws_send_failed: Could not send the programming command.
errors.cv_read_empty: The decoder did not return that CV.
errors.changelist_too_large: That change list is too large.
errors.z21_session_replaced: The Z21 connection was replaced. Try again.
errors.upstream_body_too_large: The upstream response was too large.

cv3.hint: Value × 0.9 s from stop to Vmax. Sound project may override

cv4.hint: Value × 0.9 s from Vmax to stop

cv6.hint: Default ≈ ⅓ Vmax. If CV 5 = 255, curve equals CV 6 = 85

cv9.hint: Default 55. Hundreds 1 = coreless. Tens 1–4 slower, 6–9 faster

cv15.hint: Must match CV 16 of the target decoder

cv16.hint: Separate access when several decoders share an address

cv20.hint: Value × 100 added to CV 19. Bit 7: RailCom for consist

cv21.hint: Bit = 1: function follows the consist address

cv22.hint: Headlights from consist or individual address

cv23.hint: Temporary change of CV 3. Bit 7 = 0 adds, 1 subtracts

cv24.hint: Temporary change of CV 4. Bit 7 = 0 adds, 1 subtracts

b0.on: ABC — higher voltage on the right rail

b1.on: ABC — higher voltage on the left rail

cv30.hint: Write 255 = test; read = error code; 0 = clear

mapFn.hint: Bit 0 = FO1, bit 1 = FO2, … Factory: Fn controls FOn

cv49.hint: Value × 0.4 s. Higher of CV 3 or 49 is used

cv50.hint: Value × 0.4 s. Higher of CV 4 or 50 is used

cv56.hint: Tens = P, ones = I. Effective if CV 147–149 = 0. Do not use 10, 20, … 90

cv57.hint: 0 = relative (ZIMO track). 100–255 = 10.0–25.5 V at full throttle

cv58.hint: 0 off; 150 medium; 255 maximum. Consists should not run at 100% across the range

cv59.hint: Tenths of a second before accelerating after a higher limit

cv61.hint: 97 = no left-shift (higher F keys can drive lower FOs)

cv62.hint: Tenths of a second (0–25 s) after stopping

cv63.hint: Tens: cycle time 0–9 (default 5). Ones: longer off-time

cv64.hint: Bits 7–4: key (F+1)×16. Bits 3–0: OFF time in seconds

speedTable.hint: Internal step 1–255 (CV 29 bit 4 = 1). Interpolated in 128-step mode

cv97.hint: 0–28. Toggles between own address and consist

cv100.hint: PoM read only: tenths of a volt right now

cv107.hint: (FO 1–6) × 32 + F number. Turns off front lights and that FO

cv109.hint: 1–6. Bit 7 with CV 110: auto in consist

cv111.hint: Used instead of CV 4 on emergency stop

cv114.hint: Bit = 1: output skipped by CV 60 PWM (full voltage)

cv115.hint: Effect 48: tens = pull-in time. Dimming: tens = 0, ones = PWM 0–90%

cv116.hint: Tens = time (as CV 115). Ones × 4 = step. Hundreds 1 = coupler unload

cv117.hint: Tens = off, ones = on (0 = 100 ms … 9 = 1 s). 55 = 1 s equal

cv118.hint: Bit 6: FO2 inverted; bit 7: FO4 inverted (wig-wag)

cv119.hint: With F6, outputs go to CV 60. Bit 7 = inverted

cv120.hint: Same as CV 119, F7 as key

b7.on: Inverted: low beam when key OFF

cv123.hint: 0–99. Tens = accel, ones = brake. 0 = off; 11 = strongest. SW 6.00+

cv124.hint: Bits 0–1: type (00 none, 10 = ¼, 11 full momentum off). 16 = F3 half-speed. Applies when CV 155/156 = 0

effect.hint: Effect code (bits 7–2) + direction (00 both, 01 fwd, 10 rev). 48 = uncoupler; 0/1/2 = direction only

cv137.hint: Heater when stopped. Needs a smoke effect on an FO

cv141.hint: 255 ≈ 500 m prototype (6 m HO); 50 ≈ 100 m (1.2 m HO). 0 = use CV 830–833

cv144.hint: MN: lights flash instead of a sound

cv147.hint: Full resolution. Synced from CV 56. Coreless: 30–60; 5-pole: 100–150

cv151.hint: Brake: 1–8 s short at PWM=0. Consist: tens 1–9 = 10–90% of CV 58. SW 6.00+

cv153.hint: Tenths of a second, then braking. 0 = off. Default 100

cv156.hint: 0 = CV 124; 1–28 = F; 29 = F0; 30 = MAN. Bit 7: no light change on reverse

cv157.hint: Cancels HLU and ABC stop/limit. 0 = none; 1–28 = F; 29 = F0

cv161.hint: 0 pulse +; 1 pulse −. Smart Servo RC-1: 2. Bit 0 = polarity

cv165.hint: Tenths of a second between ends. Default 30 = 3 s

cv179.hint: Max analog speed (regulated and not). Default 128. SW 5.15+

cv193.hint: 0 = off; 1–254 = seconds stopped in the loop

cv268.hint: 0 = virtual (CV 267); 1 = sensor on In2. Pulse count per revolution

cv269.hint: One louder chuff in a group of 4/6. Default 10

cv277.hint: Deviation from the recorded base load. SW 5.15+

cv282.hint: 0–25 s (30 = 3 s). Avoids hearing every step

cv287.hint: Step below which squeal starts. Stops at speed 0

cv288.hint: 0–25 s. Suppresses squeal on short shunting without cars

cv309.hint: 0 = off; 1–28 = F; 29 = F0. Time from CV 349, not CV 4

cv310.hint: 0–28; 255 = always on. ZIMO projects: F8; OEM often F1

cv311.hint: Whistle, bell, etc. Same value as CV 310 = one key

cv312.hint: Shunting with open valves. Factory F13

cv314.hint: Tenths of a second. 0–10 ≈ min. 1 s; 11–255 up to 25 s

cv349.hint: CV 4 high (50–250), this low (5–20) = coast then brake

cv352.hint: 255 = max at start / hard acceleration. Steam: pulses synced to chuffs

cv355.hint: 0 = no idle smoke; >0 = idle smoke with sound on

b4.on: Faster acceleration on a sudden full throttle

b6.off: Brake key does not block momentum

cv395.hint: Upper limit; may exceed CV 266. Default 64

inputMap.hint: 0 = 1:1; 1–28 = F→internal; 30–57 forward only; 58–86 reverse only; 101–187 inverted

cv830.hint: Only when CV 141 = 0. Factor 16× vs CV 141

cv102.hint: Bit 0 = 1: CV 980–1019 for SUSI slave instead of scripts

cv113.hint: With CV 58: compensation over the full speed range (MX used CV 10)

b1.on: Move off even if idle sound has not finished
Diesel-mech.: do not raise RPM when braking

cv185.hint: 1 = live steam, one servo: speed and direction from the servo

cv203.hint: Same as CV 201. First non-zero of 201–204 and 181–184 sets the mode

cv204.hint: Ones and tens: 0/1/2/4. 11 = both INs as logic outputs

cv250.hint: Read only. With CV 251: decoder type

cv253.hint: Read only. Whole value = unique ID

cv259.hint: Read only. CV 265 also via CV 768

cv265.hint: Steam: 1–32, diesel/electric: 32–63. Also readable via CV 768 / 259

cv271.hint: Useful up to ~30. Chuffs overlap as on the prototype

cv273.hint: Time from moving off to the valve sound

cv278.hint: Suppresses volume changes on small variations (curves). SW 6.00+

cv279.hint: How quickly the sound reacts. SW 6.00+

cv280.hint: Diesel reaction to PWM and speed step. SW 5.15+

cv290.hint: Pitch for the speed in CV 292. Default 50

cv292.hint: Step for the pitch in CV 290. Default 128

cv297.hint: Internal step where the motor becomes audible

cv298.description: Electric motor — full volume from step

b7.on: Key CV 308 triggers squeal independent of reed

cv347.hint: 0 = off; 1–28 = F. Heavy train vs engine only

cv348.hint: When CV 347 is ON. Bits 0–4. With CV 246 / 390

cv350.hint: Tenths of a second with no switchgear sound after moving off

cv354.hint: Only with CV 267. Corrects virtual-cam non-linearity. Default 11

cv357.hint: Quieter from this step; stays down while braking

cv358.hint: 0 = no reduction. Shape of the drop from CV 357

cv359.hint: Tenths of a second (0–25 s). Default 30

cv361.hint: Avoids playing too often on rapid changes. Default 20

cv362.hint: 0 = off. Second sound at higher speed (e.g. ICN)

cv363.hint: How many shifts cover the whole speed range

cv367.hint: Playback frequency vs engine speed. Default 150

cv368.hint: Difference between set and actual speed. Default 100

cv374.hint: 0 = none; 1–28 = F; 29 = F0. Forces a given sound step

cv381.hint: Audible from this step to CV 382

cv382.hint: Audible up to this step (from CV 381)

cv384.hint: How many steps to drop before the sound plays

cv386.hint: 0–15. Bit 3: no fade at sample end

cv387.description: Diesel — acceleration influence on sound step
cv387.hint: 0 = speed step only; higher = stronger accel effect

cv388.description: Diesel — braking influence on sound step

cv389.hint: How far the sound may leave the speed step

cv390.hint: When CV 347 and CV 348 bit 1. 0 or 255 = none; 128 = half

cv391.description: Idle sound when solo until step
cv391.hint: Diesel stays at idle until this step (key CV 347)

cv398.hint: How many steps to drop in 0.5 s before idle sound

cv399.hint: SW 6.00. With Swiss mapping (CV 431 = 255). Internal step

cv835.hint: Extends CV 345: how many consecutive F keys switch Set2, Set3, …

b0.on: Do not move until the start sound has finished

cv838.hint: Step 1–255 for the pitch in CV 291. Default 255

functionSoundSample.hint: Function-sound number in the project. Usually leave unchanged

functionSoundLoop.hint: Bits 0–2: loop count; 3 = looping; 4/5 = forward/reverse only; 6 = shorten on off

swiss.hint: Swiss-mapping group. F = key (29 = F0, 129–157 with bit 7). M = master. A1/A2 = outputs. CV 431 = 255: full beam

swissDim.hint: Five levels (0 = dark, 31 = full). Selected by bits 5–7 in A1/A2

servo.speedHint: Tenths of a second between ends. Default 30 = 3 s
servo.fnHint: F number driving the servo. First non-zero of 201–204 / 181–184 sets SUSI mode

panto.hint: Bit 7 = sound-dependent. Bits 6–5: direction (00 always, 01 fwd, 10 rev, 11 with key)

random.durationHint: Seconds. Z1 factory compressor; Z2 coal shovelling; Z3 injector
random.loopHint: Bit 3 = at standstill; bit 6 = while moving

switchDur.hint: Seconds. 0 = play once from the start

conn.soundHint: Usually set by the project — leave unless you know you need to

script.hint: Values read by ZSP scripts. CV 102 bit 0 hands them to a SUSI slave

cv2.hint: Low end of the curve. Keep CV 2 < CV 6 < CV 5

cv15.hint: NMRA decoder lock, together with CV 16

cv16.hint: Writing the same value as CV 15 unlocks

cv28.hint: Bit 0 CH1, bit 1 CH2, bit 7 RailCom Plus

cv32.hint: Page: 0 outputs, 1 slot volumes, 3–5/8–10 function mapping

cv47.hint: Bit sum. DCC-only decoders ignore this

cv63.hint: All sounds. 0 = mute. Lower if you hear distortion

speedTable.hintEnds: CV 67 = 1, CV 94 = 255 — ends of the 28-point curve

cv96.hint: ROCO MultiMaus: hundreds digit of the CV number

cv97.hint: ROCO: tens and ones digits of the CV number

cv98.hint: LokMaus II: hundreds digit of the value

cv99.hint: Writing this programs the target CV from CV 96–98

cv101.hint: Factor n/128 when shunting is on. 64 ≈ 50%

cv103.hint: n/128 scales CV 3/4. 128 = unchanged; 0 = very light

cv104.hint: n/128 scales CV 3/4. Takes precedence over CV 103

cv111.hint: Unit × 16 ms minimum speed after a direction change

cv124.hint: Default 21. Bit 2 turns the sound startup delay off

cv129.hint: Offset for turning functions on relative to start voltage

cv130.hint: Offset for turning the motor off

cv143.hint: n/128 relative to the trigger pulse

soundCv.hint: Sound selection depends on the project

brakeDecel.hint: Percent deducted from CV 4. Example: CV 4=60, this CV=90 → ≈39

cv247.hint: × 0.016 s. Should be longer than CV 248

cv253.hint: 0 = linear from entering the sector; >0 = run, then constant effort

cv254.hint: 0 = normal timing (CV 3/4). Active in brake sectors

cv2.hint: 0 often best for a smooth gearbox; 3 or 4–5 if step 1 jerks

cv4.hint: Same as CV 3: 4 ≈ 1 s from max to min

cv6.hint: With CV 2 and CV 5 forms the 3-point curve

cv8.hint: Read: NMRA ID. Write 1 = factory reset

cv19.hint: If > 0, speed and direction follow this address

cv28.hint: Bit 0: CH1, bit 1: CH2, bit 3: auto detection / ABC

cv29.hint: Long address is bit 3 (not NMRA bit 5)

cv51.hint: Higher = more stable creep; too high oscillates

cv52.hint: Factory 0; no improvement in RailBOX tests

cv54.hint: Derivative; voltage change on speed-step jumps

cv55.hint: Same as CV 54 at low speed

cv60.hint: Back-EMF regulation, not the CV 5 curve

cv61.hint: Same encoding as CV 3; 4 ≈ 1 s. Faster than running (CV 3 = 34)

effect.hint: 0 bulb; 1–2 flash 1; 3–4 flash 2; 5 pulse; 6–7 sequence; 9 servo. Modifiers: +16/+32/+64 fade, +128 sequence once

cv192.hint: Write the function number first, then CV 193

cv200.hint: Function key; value > 68 disables Wi-Fi. Factory F28

cv205.hint: % of file length, not less than CV 204
